This project is a work in progress - resurrecting the F3 programming language.

Lazy and reactive self-adjusting computation with mutation

Support for generics including type constructors

Syntax - "plain english" where possible

Higher order functions

{{{
function curry of (a, b, c) 
     from (f is function from (a, b) to c) 
     to function from a to (function from b to c)
{
    function from (x is a) to function from b to c
    {
        function from (y is b) to c
        {
            f(x, y)
        }
    }
}

function uncurry of (a, b, c) 
    from (f is function from a to (function from b to c)) 
    to function from (a, b) to c
{
    function(x is a, y is b) returns c
    {
        f(x)(y)
    }
}
}}}

Monad Comprehensions
{{{


// Lazy infinite streams                                                              

public class Stream of a is Comonad of (Stream, a), Monad of (Stream, a) 
{

    public const now is a;
    public const later is Stream of a;

    // zip lifts a binary operator to one over Streams                                
    public function zip of (b, c)
        from (binOp is function from (a, b) to c,
                  xs is Stream of b) 
        to Stream of c
    {
        Stream of c
        {
            now: bind binOp(now, xs.now)
            later: bind later.zip(binOp, xs.later)
        }
    }

    // map lifts a unary operator to one over Streams                                 
    override public function of b
        map(unaryOp is function from a to b) returns Stream of b
    {
        Stream of b
        {
            now: bind unaryOp(this.now)
            later: bind this.later.map(unaryOp)
        }
    }

    // flatmap lifts a Stream constructor to a unary operator over Streams            
    override public function of b
        flatmap(ctor is function from a to Stream of b) returns Stream of b
    {
        val d = bound function(x is a) returns b { ctor(x).now }
        var h = bind d(now);
        var t = bind for (x in later) d(x);
        Stream of b
        {
            now: bind h
            later: bind t
        }
    }

    // coflatmap lifts a Stream destructor to a unary operator over Streams           
    override function of b
        coflatmap(dtor is function from Stream of a to b) returns Stream of b
    {
        Stream of b
        {
            now: bind dtor(this)
            later: bind later.coflatmap(dtor)
        }
    }

    override public function extract() returns a { now }

    public bound function followedBy(xs is Stream of a) returns Stream of a
    {
        Stream of a
        {
            now: bind now
            later: bind xs
        }
    }
}


// lifts a value to a Stream by repeating it indefinitely, i.e  x, x, x, ...          
public function of a repeat(x is a) returns Stream of a
{
    Stream of a
    {
        now: x
        override val later = this
    }
}

// creates an infinite stream of 3s
val zs = bind for (x in repeat(1), y in repeat(2)) { x + y }

}}}
